title: Akathist Convent vs Celeritas Squadron
lede:
Akathist Convent won 32-4 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4, holding the centre in every round and all three objectives from Round 2 on.

It was decided by bodies on the ground: ten units against five, four of them 10 RP Covenant Levies squads, and the Celeritas Squadron never controlled an objective; its only VP were the 1 a round BREAK THEIR HOLD paid for standing beside the centre.
result_line: Akathist Convent win 32-4 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7); an Objective Area is the objective square and the eight around it. Akathist Convent set up along row 12 in front of its HQ at (7,13): Covenant Levies 1 with the Field Confessor at (3,12) for the left objective, Covenant Levies 2 at (4,12), Maphorion Nuns with Abbatissa Dolorosa at (5,12), Covenant Levies 3 at (7,12), Covenant Levies 4 at (9,12), the Saint-Militant (in the air) at (10,12) and Myrrhbearer Sisters with the Seven-Sword Intercessor at (11,12). Celeritas Squadron put Caesar - Divus Imperator (Mounted) with his Palatine Custos (Mounted) at (9,1) and the Comitatus Armored Carrier at (5,1) with Retiarius Squad and Malleus Sappers aboard, beside its HQ at (7,1). The Squadron had Priority all battle with fewer units on the battlefield (4 to 11 at the start). The set-up gave the Convent a body for every objective and the Squadron two fast pieces and one transport to contest three. This is the replay of a battle that froze in Round 1 while the AI planned the loaded carrier's moves; on the same seed after the fix, the slowest AI decision took 1.9 s.

1.title: The Convent walks onto the centre and the left

feed.text: Primaries revealed: ERADICATE THE FOE for the Convent, BREAK THEIR HOLD for the Squadron. Secondaries kept: LAST STAND and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY. The Squadron chose Tactica Mercurii and gave Palatine Custos (Mounted) a Scouting Order (0 CP, +2 PER); neither bought anything. The Convent placed Mantle of Mercy on Abbatissa Dolorosa, Maphorion Nuns and the Saint-Militant and spent 2 of its 2 CP on Double Time for Myrrhbearer Sisters, a move the record says was in reach without it.

Caesar and the Palatine Custos rode 9,1 to 9,6. The Comitatus Armored Carrier drove to 7,5 and dropped Retiarius Squad at 8,6 and Malleus Sappers at 6,6, both inside the centre's Objective Area; its Overwatch took 1 off Myrrhbearer Sisters as they advanced to 7,8. Maphorion Nuns with Abbatissa Dolorosa reached 8,8, Covenant Levies 1 with the Field Confessor 2,8, and the other Levies 5,9, 11,9 and 10,10. The Saint-Militant flew to 13,7, on the right objective, but (13,7) scored nobody that round.

Malleus Sappers' Volcanus Pistols killed a Myrrhbearer Sister. Retiarius Squad's Net Launcher put IMMOBILIZED on Maphorion Nuns and Abbatissa Dolorosa until the end of Round 2; they were already standing in the centre's area, so it cost them nothing they needed. Fourteen units had no legal action. Praying gave the Convent 10 Mana.

The Convent scored the centre on OC 13 vs 6 (3 VP) and the left on 11 vs 0 (2 VP); BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Squadron 1 for its two units in the centre. The log has Pietas +4 for the Squadron, to Tier II (the round's snapshot reads 0 before the ladder pays). 5-1.

2.title: Retiarius Squad charges into the Seven-Sword Intercessor

feed.text: Secondaries kept: FOCUSED FIRE for the Convent, TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET for the Squadron, and the Convent picked (1,7), the objective it already held. The Squadron spent 1 CP on Double Time for Malleus Sappers, who then did not move. Mantle of Mercy went to Maphorion Nuns, Myrrhbearer Sisters and Covenant Levies 1.

Caesar and the Palatine Custos rode to 7,6, into the centre's area, and met Myrrhbearer Sisters' Overwatch: with the PROVIDENCE Miracle, four natural 6s through Go to Ground (via Caesar, 0 CP) did 6 (18 to 12, a Candidatus dead). Retiarius Squad charged Myrrhbearer Sisters, the Seven-Sword Intercessor and Covenant Levies 2 from 8,6 to 6,8; Covenant Levies 2 failed its Fall Back test (3, needing 5) and lost a model breaking away to 6,10. Covenant Levies 3 walked onto the right objective at 12,7. Caesar's Fulmen Iovis Overwatch took 4 and two Levies off Covenant Levies 4 and left it PARALYZED; the Palatine Custos's Overwatch at the same unit rolled no dice ("skipped - FREE weapon already used this Battle Round"). The carrier went back west, 7,5 to 3,6.

Retiarius Squad's charge put 4 trident hits on Myrrhbearer Sisters for no HP lost (Mantle of Mercy stopped one). The Seven-Sword Intercessor's counterattack, 4 hits from the Dolorous Greatsword, did 10 (15 to 5), and in the Convent's turn, with the EXALTATION Miracle, its 5 hits finished the squad: Retiarius Squad destroyed in the centre's area, 24 RP. The Saint-Militant's Martyr's Longrifle hit the Palatine Custos for 5 (12 to 7). Malleus Sappers killed another Myrrhbearer Sister despite the Convent's Go to Ground (1 CP); the carrier took 2 off Covenant Levies 1. Abbatissa Dolorosa cast Introit on Maphorion Nuns (2 Mana). The Palatine Custos, its pistols spent by that Overwatch, had no legal action.
The Convent held all three: the centre on OC 12 vs 10 (3 VP), the left 10 vs 0 and the right 10 vs 0 (2 + 2). ERADICATE THE FOE paid 2 for the Retiarius kill, BREAK THEIR HOLD the Squadron 1. 14-2.

3.title: The Maphorion Nuns charge and the Palatine Custos fall

feed.text: Secondaries kept: IRON GRIP and INTO THE FRAY; FOCUSED FIRE expired for the Convent. The Convent spent all 3 CP on Double Time for Covenant Levies 1, which then moved one square, 1,6 to 2,6: bought nothing.

Covenant Levies 4 moved to 6,8 under Overwatch from the Palatine Custos and Malleus Sappers; both rolled no dice, the same FREE-weapon skip as in Round 2. The Saint-Militant came into the centre at 8,7. Free of IMMOBILIZED and answering the Introit, Maphorion Nuns with Abbatissa Dolorosa charged from 8,8 onto the objective at 7,7, into Caesar, the Palatine Custos and Malleus Sappers.

Caesar attacked first, but the charging Nuns struck first (INI 9 +3): DUAL WIELD doubled their dice to 20, 8 hits for 6 on the Palatine Custos (8 to 2), and Abbatissa Dolorosa's Relic Sword did the last 2. Palatine Custos (Mounted) destroyed, 80 RP, in the centre's area. Caesar's Imperator Spatha answered with 4 on Maphorion Nuns (10 to 6, two Nuns; Mantle of Mercy stopped one hit), and Myrrhbearer Sisters' Anointing of Bethany covered the Nuns. Malleus Sappers' mauls missed with all three dice. The carrier hit Covenant Levies 1 for 3; their return fire, under the Squadron's Go to Ground (1 CP), did nothing. The Field Confessor cast Introit on Covenant Levies 1 (2 Mana).

The Convent held the centre on OC 18 vs 8, the left 9 vs 0 and the right 10 vs 0, 7 VP. ERADICATE THE FOE paid 2 and IRON GRIP completed (+2 VP, +1 CP). BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Squadron 1, and its Pietas reached Tier IV (10). 25-3.

4.title: A Legionnaire Squad arrives as the Convent passes 30

feed.text: The BENEDICTION Miracle healed Covenant Levies 1 for 1. The Squadron switched to Tactica Iovis and spent 5 of its 6 CP on Troop Requisition: a Legionnaire Squad at 7,2. The Convent spent 2 CP on Double Time for the Seven-Sword Intercessor, which bought nothing. Secondaries kept: FORWARD DEPLOYMENT and DEEP REACH; LAST STAND expired, the Convent never having a unit Below Half-Strength on an objective.

The Legionnaire Squad marched to 7,5 and the carrier to 5,5. Malleus Sappers failed their Fall Back test (4, needing 6) and lost a model breaking away from the Nuns to 5,4. The Saint-Militant landed on a charge into the Legionnaire Squad at 7,4. Then the Convent emptied the centre: Maphorion Nuns with Abbatissa Dolorosa broke away from Caesar on a 6 to 8,10, Myrrhbearer Sisters with the Seven-Sword Intercessor went to 9,9, and only Covenant Levies 4 (6,8 to 7,8) stayed in the Objective Area.

Caesar's Fulmen Iovis put 4 into Covenant Levies 4 (16 to 12, two Levies) and PARALYZED it again. The Saint-Militant's Sword of the Risen did 2 to the Legionnaire Squad (10 to 8). Covenant Levies 3 put 6 hits on Caesar and he saved all six; Myrrhbearer Sisters took 2 off the carrier (10 to 8) through Go to Ground (via Caesar, 0 CP). The Field Confessor's Introit on Covenant Levies 1 (2 Mana) changed nothing.
The centre stayed the Convent's on OC 6 vs 5, Covenant Levies 4 against Caesar alone, and the flanks on 9 vs 0 and 10 vs 0: 7 VP. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Squadron 1. 32-4, the Convent past 30.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Akathist Convent took 26 of its 32 VP from objectives (5, then 7 in each of Rounds 2 to 4), 4 from ERADICATE THE FOE (the Retiarius Squad in Round 2, the Palatine Custos in Round 3, both in the centre's area) and 2 from IRON GRIP. Celeritas Squadron scored 4, all from BREAK THEIR HOLD at 1 VP a round: the card pays that for each objective the enemy holds with a friendly unit in its area, and the Squadron always had someone standing beside the centre. It never took an objective away, which is what pays the card's 3.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

The Convent's cheapest units did the scoring. The four 10 RP Covenant Levies squads and the Field Confessor took 20.3 of the 32 VP: Covenant Levies 3 walked onto the right objective in Round 2 and stood there alone for 6.6 VP, all 6 of its objective VP hinged on it (65.9 per 100 RP); Covenant Levies 1 with the Field Confessor held the left all four rounds (4.6 and 4.0); Covenant Levies 4 held the centre by itself in Round 4 (5.1 VP, 3 hinged). The elite units did the killing: the Seven-Sword Intercessor did 15 damage and took the Retiarius Squad apart, counterattack and then the finish; Maphorion Nuns and Abbatissa Dolorosa killed the 80 RP Palatine Custos on the charge. The Convent lost no unit.

For the Squadron, Caesar - Divus Imperator (Mounted) did 12 damage, 8 of it to Covenant Levies 4 and 4 to the Maphorion Nuns, and killed nothing. The Palatine Custos (Mounted) made no action in three rounds. The Comitatus Armored Carrier delivered its two squads in Round 1, then spent three rounds on the left flank at 3,6, 2,4 and 5,5, putting 5 into Covenant Levies 1 without ever entering the left objective's area. The Squadron lost 104 RP and destroyed nothing.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

What the Squadron could not do

It had five units and a 5 CP reinforcement against ten, with 165 RP in one leader-and-bodyguard pair. Every secondary it kept asked for something it never had: TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY, TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET (the Convent named the left objective, which Covenant Levies 1 never left) and DEEP REACH all needed an objective under its control, and INTO THE FRAY needed a charge after Round 2, when its only charger, the Retiarius Squad, was already dead. The Pietas ladder climbed to Tier IV and nothing in the record used it; Tactica Mercurii and Tactica Iovis touched 29 attacks for +0 expected HP.

{{chart:attrition}}

The AI, not the army

  • FREE-weapon Overwatch, an engine bug: the Palatine Custos's Overwatch in Round 2 and its and Malleus Sappers' in Round 3 spent the FREE use and then skipped the weapon ("skipped - FREE weapon already used this Battle Round"), so three Overwatch shots rolled nothing. All three were at Covenant Levies 4, the unit that held the centre alone in Round 4 on OC 6 vs 5.
  • Round 4, the Convent's centre: its AI pulled three of its four centre units out: Maphorion Nuns broke away from Caesar (the Fall Back record calls it doubtful: 2.31 expected melee damage against 13 HP), Myrrhbearer Sisters walked to 9,9 on a 2 CP Double Time that bought nothing, and the Saint-Militant charged out of the centre into the Legionnaire Squad. The 3 VP that took the Convent past 30 rested on a one-OC margin: a tie, one unit each, would have scored nobody and left the Convent on 29 for another round. It cost nothing here because the Squadron had no way to score.
  • Command Points for nothing: the Convent spent 7 CP on three Double Times (Round 1 Myrrhbearer Sisters, Round 3 Covenant Levies 1 for a one-square move, Round 4 the Seven-Sword Intercessor) and the record prices all three at nothing; the Squadron's Round 2 Double Time went to Malleus Sappers, who did not move. The Convent also ended with 18 Mana unspent, casting only a 2 Mana Introit a round.
  • The Fall Back record is inflated: of its seven entries, the Round 3 "caught by others" (Palatine Custos) and "risky hold" (Malleus Sappers) are charge-planning probes. When they were asked, Maphorion Nuns and Abbatissa Dolorosa were still at 8,8, two squares from 7,6 and 6,6.

The result is the army more than the AI. The Convent's mass of cheap OC against a five-unit army with one transport decided it, and the Squadron's AI could not have fixed that by playing better. The FREE-weapon bug made the Squadron's Overwatch weaker; it did not change who won.

closing: The Convent put a 10 RP Levies squad on each objective and let its Nuns and Intercessor deal with whatever came to contest them. The Celeritas Squadron's mounted bodyguard and its carrier were too few to take any of the three, and four VP from standing next to the centre was all it had.
